title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E03 — Gangs, Prisons & Meth Queens
The Clinton administration's support of NAFTA inadvertently opens the door to Mexican cartels; a crackdown on violence leads to mass incarceration; a celebrity's sister becomes a meth lord; powerful cartels begin a war for dominance.

title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E02 — Cocaine, Cartels & Crack Downs
Cocaine gives rise to cartels; CIA shadow wars contribute to the first narco-state; crack floods into the United States as an unintended consequence of the fight against communism; a former DEA agent discusses U.S. culpability in the cocaine trade.

title: Mobsters
description:
S04 E06 — Carmine \"The Snake\" Persico
Carmine Persico stands as one of the most enduring Godfathers in mafia history.

title: America's War on Drugs
description:
S01 E04 — Heroin, Terrorists & Kings of Pain
The intertwining of the War on Drugs and the War on Terror transforms Afghanistan into a narco-state; American intervention helps give rise to El Chapo and the super cartels; the pharmaceutical industry becomes a supplier of addictive substances.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E99
Undercover police risk identity loss. This special shares their real stories.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E04 — Too Close to Home
ATF Special Agents Dobyns and Kilday put their best feet forward only to have their lives put on the line.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E05 — The Edge of Cover
An undercover NYPD officer and an ATF special agent learn not to trust a suspect's demeanor; forced to rely on their cover teams for support, Shaulene Wright and Scott Perala navigate the challenging terrain of deception in the undercover world.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E07 — The Cost of Happiness
One FBI undercover agent meets with suspects in Denmark in an effort to retrieve one of the world's lost treasures, while another agent takes on an unlikely suspect believed to be planning a murder for hire.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E06 — Small Towns, Big Crimes
Undercover agents Lyle Kirian and Brian Townsend embed themselves in two different, but equally dangerous worlds in order to investigate suspected local gang members and the Mexican cartel.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E10 — Money Murder and Malicious Intent
On his last day as an undercover agent, Bergen County Detective Carlos James experiences his first shootout; ATF agent Jenn Eskew poses as a hit woman to investigate a possible murder for hire.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E01 — High Stakes
Undercover ATF and DEA Agents are reminded to never judge a book by its cover and to always be on their toes; even small-time suspects have the potential to unleash terror, and no place seems safe or off-limits.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E01 — Naked ATV
A naked man allegedly steals an ATV; a man who apparently was feeding the alligators gets a visit from police; a man in Alaska robs a liquor store by smashing into the entrance with a stolen front-loader.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E02 — Cat Ladies Lockup
Two senior citizens get locked up for trespassing while trapping stray cats; a man is arrested after pouring milk on his head while streaking through a store; police search for a man who tried to steal a wheelchair while its owner was still in it.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E03 — Drunk Horse & Buggy
A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country; a man proposes to his girlfriend while getting arrested; an aquarium worker helps catch a shark thief; a horse & buggy turns dangerous when a drunk man is operating it.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E04 — Lion Lady
A bride and her caterer are accused of drugging the wedding guests; a woman climbs into the lion's den at The Bronx Zoo; Public outcry as an Alabama grandma is arrested for not paying her trash bill.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E05 — Napping Burglar
A man decides to interrupt his crime to make a pizza; police track down a man who jumped through the roof of a port-a-potty; an unwanted intruder is arrested after he fell asleep in the middle of a crime.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E06 — Snake in the Pants
A man gets stuck in a chimney while trying to rob a house; pet store owners catch a thief with stolen snakes in his pants; a man breaks into an escape room and can't escape.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E07 — Golf Streaker
A man streaks across a golf course, delaying a tournament; a dead fish is eerily placed on the front porch of a house; two men climb the Golden Gate Bridge; an escapee gets caught in a very weird place.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E08 — Hanging on the Hood
A man hangs on the hood of his car while his ex-girlfriend drives it on the highway; an intoxicated woman flees from airport police on a motorized suitcase; a man take a selfie with his daughter inside an elephant enclosure at the zoo.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E09 — Doorbell Licker
An aspiring rapper is arrested after performing on top of a billboard; a man is caught licking the doorbell intercom of a home; a detained shoplifting suspect escapes her handcuffs and steals a police car.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E10 — Scary Wedding
A suspect flees from a high-speed car chase while carrying her infant child; state troopers catch a man with a stolen utility pole strapped to the roof of his car; a catering hall owner flips out on wedding guests.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E12 — Takeout Drugs
A man leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen mail truck; a restaurant owner is arrested after hiding drugs in a takeout box; a pizza delivery guy helps the cops arrest a thief.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E01 — I Have to Poop!
A desperate woman needs to poop during a traffic stop; a mom is busted sneaking into a school dressed as her daughter; a man jumps into a store's 24,000-gallon aquarium and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E02 — Ride or Die

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E07 — Love and Hate
Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983; the investigation is thwarted, and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E08 — Ice Cold in Denver
In 1980, radio intern Helene Pruszynski is found brutalized in a snowy field; after 37 years of fruitless leads, investigators tap into a public genealogy website that leads them across the country to the killer they've been hunting.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E09 — Murder by Moonlight
On Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field; the investigation yields many leads, but no true suspect; after more than two decades on ice, the case is revived when DNA phenotyping puts a face to the killer.
